goal: Write a formal design specification for viewport-normalized creation and editing of canvas blocks, text, images and media in zeroxB, with an initial zoom of 65 percent and a supported viewport range of 10 to 600 percent.
non_goals: Do not implement or modify runtime behavior in this task.
Do not add a new rich-text editor or change existing content types.
Do not make AI-created blocks depend directly on the current camera zoom.
Do not migrate or rewrite existing canvas documents.
Do not expose or modify the configured localhost AI credential.
acceptance_criteria: The specification defines creation-time conversion as canvas size equals screen size divided by the captured viewport zoom.
The specification covers direct mouse drawing, pasted text, dropped images, files, links and media cards.
The specification defines perceived font-size editing, image sizing, block sizing, undo behavior and compatibility with existing content.
The specification fixes the initial zoom at 65 percent, minimum zoom at 10 percent and maximum zoom at 600 percent.
The specification states that AI-created content uses nearby block scale or a 100 percent fallback rather than current viewport zoom.
The specification includes extreme-zoom safeguards, failure behavior and verification scenarios.
The document contains no placeholders, contradictions or ambiguous conversion rules and is committed for user review.
context_sources: src/app/core/main/canvas/canvas-editor.tsx owns React Flow viewport state, creation entry points, viewport persistence and fit-view behavior.
src/app/core/main/canvas/nodes/canvas-nodes.tsx renders block text, images and resizers.
src/lib/canvas/content-ingest.ts defines pasted and dropped content defaults.
src/types/canvas.ts defines persisted viewport and node data.
notes: Use the fixed UTF-8 I/O baseline.
Direct user creation captures zoom once at gesture or ingest start and does not change if zoom moves mid-gesture.
Existing content is never rescaled merely because the viewport changes.
The design must remain compatible with the current infinite-canvas and undo/redo model.
Stop after writing and committing the specification so the user can add requirements.
